outcome_label_contract.name: HOME_WIN
outcome_label_contract.definition: HOME_WIN=1 iff the canonical home side's full-game final team_score is greater than the canonical away side's full-game final team_score; otherwise HOME_WIN=0.
outcome_label_contract.source: the same frozen SportsDataverse ESPN WNBA team-box assets already pinned in R1A4/R3 custody

controlled_model.note: BASE_R2_FEATURE_LOGIT is a controlled research baseline built from frozen R2 state features; it is not a claim of exact production-R2 probability replay.

preprocessing.directional_rule: For side-symmetric numeric or boolean fields use HOME minus AWAY after boolean-to-0/1 conversion. H2H likewise uses home-minus-away directional fields.
preprocessing.standardization: StandardScaler fit on training seasons only inside each fold, then applied unchanged to that fold's target season.
preprocessing.missing_or_nonfinite_policy: FAIL_CLOSED; no imputation and no target-row dropping. R3B1 certification already reports complete finite inputs.

metrics.ece10_definition: Ten fixed probability bins [0.0,0.1),...,[0.9,1.0], weighted by row count; sum absolute bin mean-prediction minus bin observed-rate gaps.
metrics.log_loss_clipping: clip probability to [1e-15,1-1e-15] for numerical evaluation only

single_family_incremental_gate.comparison: each BASE_R2+family versus BASE_R2_FEATURE_LOGIT on the pooled 2022-2025 rolling-origin OOS rows
single_family_incremental_gate.minimum_improvement: pooled Brier improvement >=0.001 OR pooled log-loss improvement >=0.002
single_family_incremental_gate.seasonal_stability: At least one proper score must improve versus BASE_R2 in at least 2 of the 4 target seasons.
single_family_incremental_gate.failure_rule: A family that fails this gate cannot enter bounded combinations in R3B2.

bounded_combination_protocol.eligible_families: only families passing the single-family incremental gate

combination_advancement_gate.reference: best qualifying single family by pooled log loss, then Brier, then lexical candidate ID
combination_advancement_gate.minimum_improvement: pooled Brier improvement >=0.001 OR pooled log-loss improvement >=0.002 versus that reference
combination_advancement_gate.seasonal_stability: At least one proper score improves versus the reference in at least 2 target seasons.

bounded_combination_protocol.winner_rule: Among advancing combinations choose lowest pooled OOS log loss; tie-break by lowest Brier, then fewer R3 families, then lexical candidate ID. If no combination advances, retain the best qualifying single. If no single qualifies, retain BASE_R2_FEATURE_LOGIT and disable multidimensional Elite feasibility.

family_contribution_definition.calculation: Within each fitted target fold, family logit contribution is the sum of fitted beta_j times the train-standardized target x_j for columns belonging to that family.

selective_elite_feasibility_screen.passing_meaning: DEVELOPMENT_FEASIBILITY_ONLY; does not certify probability calibration, cross-sport eligibility, production deployment, or wagering.

anti_leakage_and_no_retune.if_r3b2_fails: Record failure. Any altered features, thresholds, models or gates require a separately versioned future research contract; they cannot be presented as this frozen R3B2 result.

outcome_opening_authorization.authorized_purpose: Run the frozen R3B2 rolling-origin development evaluation exactly once per operationally equivalent rerun; operational bug fixes may rerun without changing science.
